title: reelkit video (video.json)
description: The source of truth for one video. `reelkit build` regenerates video/index.html from it; every time in here is a RECORDING time (seconds in recording.mp4, as in markers.json), so trims and templates can change without re-timing anything.

title.description: Cover title: the task, e.g. "Find a customer".

subtitle.description: Cover subtitle: the benefit or context.

sections.description: Overrides demo.config.json `sections` per slot, e.g. { "intro": "minimal", "recap": "none" }. Run `reelkit templates` for the list.

intro.description: Opening section; frame 0 is the poster. Kit: poster, minimal, split.

recap.description: Steps card after the recording, or "none". Kit: steps, compact, none.

outro.description: Closing brand card. Kit: wordmark, compact, endcard.

logo.description: Overrides demo.config.json `brand.logo`: an .svg/.png/.webp relative to the project root, or null for the text wordmark.

start.description: Recording seconds to skip (usually the login).

end.description: Recording second to stop at. Default: the end.

music.description: Music bed: a file (relative to the project root) for this video only, false for none, null/omitted for demo.config.json `music.file`.

callouts.description: Numbered step pills over the recording; they also become the recap. Give each a `marker` (a markers.json label) or an `at`.

text.description: Imperative step in the UI's language, ≤ 6 words.

marker.description: markers.json label this callout is timed from.

offset.description: Seconds after the marker (negative: before). Keeps the callout tied to its marker when you nudge it.

at.description: Recording time instead of a marker (manual recordings).

duration.description: Seconds on screen. Default: until the next callout, max 3 s.

group.description: Role tag (two-actor videos). Default: taken from the hand-off cards.

cursor.description: The cursor layer (recordings with record.cursor "layer", the default since reelkit 0.4): false hides it, or tune it. Has no effect when the cursor is filmed in.

size.description: Arrow size in recording CSS px. Default 44 (the classic macOS-style arrow).

ripple.description: The brand-coloured ring on each press. Default true.

zooms.description: Zoom-ins on the framed recording. Prefer `clicks`: timing and focus are computed from the cursor so the zoom rides along with the glide.

clicks.description: [first, last] click numbers (1-based, markers.json `clicks`) the zoom frames. Timing and focus are computed.

x.description: Focus point, fraction of the frame width. Default: centred on the clicks.

y.description: Focus point, fraction of the frame height.

at.description: Manual zoom: recording time the zoom-in starts (instead of `clicks`).

duration.description: Manual zoom: seconds from zoom-in start to zoomed-out.
